# chameleon_warehouses (Data Source)

List all catalogs (warehouses) on the platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all catalogs (warehouses) on the platform.
data "chameleon_warehouses" "all" {}

output "warehouse_names" {
  value = data.chameleon_warehouses.all.names
}

output "warehouses" {
  value = data.chameleon_warehouses.all.warehouses
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `names` (List of String) Warehouse (catalog) names.
- `warehouses` (Attributes List) All warehouses with their descriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--warehouses))
